model.label: Model data, not observation
model.observing_system: MERRA-2 is a reanalysis: a weather model that blends in satellite and ground observations to rebuild past weather. The observations it blends in changed over the record, for example when new satellite instruments arrived in the late 1990s and the 2000s. So part of a long-term change can come from changes in the observing system and not from the climate.
